text: CHANGE rewrite the Flutter plugin: RxDB runs in QuickJS via `fjs` and stores data with the SQLite trial storage via the Dart `sqlite3` package. Queries, observables, documents, local documents, schema migrations and replication handlers (pull, push, pull stream) are usable directly from Dart. A custom JavaScript bundle can switch the storage to the RxDB Premium SQLite storage with `startRxDBFlutterBridge({ storage })` and `createRxDatabase(jsBundleAsset: ...)`, and the `rxdb` Dart package is published to pub.dev on each release
